entities.name: Matti Päts
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matti Päts was an Estonian politician. He was a member of VII Riigikogu. Born to politician Viktor Päts in Tallinn, he was a grandson of Estonian statesman Konstantin Päts and writer Jaan Lattik. Päts died on 14 November 2024, at the age of 91.
